items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Against Les Brown who had Randy Brooks as a trumpet player there... Randy Brooks played so much... Randy Brooks featured on trumpet

ctx.x: Were those competitions quite common in those days? Or just --

Battles of jazz were great in those days. We don't have those now. They were great. Like Fletcher Henderson and Glen Gray and his Casa Loma band (unintelligible) did thirty-one one-nighters of jazz in battles of music in the universities all over the country, like the University of Illinois, University of Michigan, and actually, they had two bandstands set up, you know, and I followed Fletcher on these things too. And of course, we played a battle of music with one band. I'll never forget it. The University of…
